kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
wire.summary: Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.

wire.title: Huang says he'd be "honored" to return to Nvidia as he agrees to testify to Congress
wire.summary: The former Nvidia CEO's comments come as some in Silicon Valley have tried to argue that Huang was pushed out of the company too quickly amid a swirl of national security scandals.

wire.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
wire.summary: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

wire.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
wire.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

wire.title: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
wire.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

wire.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
wire.summary: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.

wire.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
wire.summary: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

wire.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
wire.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

wire.title: More people are getting the flu. Should you get a flu shot before you travel?
wire.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, just as millions of Americans are expected to travel for the holidays. Another thing that's upon us? Cold and flu season.

wire.title: Does locking up a student's cell phone improve test scores? A new study suggests so
wire.summary: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.

wire.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
wire.summary: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

wire.title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
wire.summary: One of the key symbols of Russia's occupation of Ukraine has suffered major damage after a seven-stage attack by Kyiv.

wire.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
wire.summary: Huang says he has had an "outpouring" of calls from investors and others calling for him to return.

wire.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
wire.summary: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

wire.title: Russian military plane crashes killing all 19 on board
wire.summary: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

wire.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
wire.summary: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.
